caption: The video captures a close-up kitchen scene in which a person in a white top and cream trousers stands behind a white counter holding a black induction cooktop. A dark frying pan rests on the cooktop, its glossy red-brown sausages releasing thin wisps of steam. The hand on the right grips a wooden slotted spatula whose head lies in the pan, while the bracelet-wearing arm on the left settles onto the counter edge after an early blurred motion. The framing gradually widens, revealing more of the pan's rim and handle. Three glossy sausages lie roughly parallel, with the spatula moving among them. The spatula tilts, lifts slightly, and presses down on a sausage, nudging it. A clear glass plate stays partly visible at the right edge against blurred white cabinets.
relations: The wooden spatula head rests among the sausages, tilting and pressing to nudge one as it moves.
Hot sausages release thin steam wisps that rise above the pan rim.
